source_roles.method: Complete exact source body personally read and analyzed under lens04; any stated counterpart textual deltas personally consumed. No hash-only coverage.

groups.contract: Church layout arithmetic and indexing use the actual frozen programme admission
groups.disposition: The entire1812-line body was personally read in seven contiguous ranges:1..270,271..540,541..810,811..1080,1081..1350,1351..1620,1621..1812. Fresh actual generate_structure first calls validate_church_program. That owner requires exactly URBAN_BRICK_BASILICA and rectangle28×14 for an urban church; nave_bays4, choir_bays2, bay_length_cells3 and other shape fields are fixed. Thus nave_axes[0], first-bay span after .60 inset, count casts and bounded layout products have direct ordinary-input proofs. Raw public ChurchProgram with zero bays is not an accepted generate() counterexample. The ChurchProgram validation was a bounded required dependency check, not a fresh exhaustive restart of lens03.

groups.contract: Church structural geometry retains explicit support roles and fallible computed values
groups.disposition: Node and solid closures allocate monotone local slots, readmit Position/CuboidDimensions/Radians/SpatialBounds, and preserve owner/support provenance. Multi-support solids increment the interface slot after each record rather than reusing a single interface ID. Fixed two/four-member arrays,72 treads,13 ladder rungs and four bell-floor patches establish index bounds. Tread attachment index clamps1..70 before reading index/index+1 from72 values. Directions for five apse facets are noncoincident under the frozen radius/angles. Native pointed-arch radius, frame rotations, vault springing, stair and bell routes still require their exact geometry/audit consumers; no successful generated asset or complete physical clearance is asserted.

groups.contract: Temporary clerestory host identity is replaced before final opening publication
groups.disposition: Each clerestory initially calls wall_solid with shared owner70000 and slot0. That intermediate duplication is not promoted as a final defect: the actual subsequent window schedule calls resolve_church_pointed_window; freshly read church_windows36..45 removes all solids with the old host IDs and their corresponding support-interface IDs before constructing serial-derived replacement slots0x20000+serial*0x40. The first replacement removes the temporary duplicates, and each scheduled wall receives its own final opening geometry. No claim that all later surface/graph identities are globally unique without their remaining source review.

groups.contract: Physical church service and public routes remain separate declared gameplay modes
groups.disposition: Bell geometry uses the shared role-based hollow bell/axle compiler, with fixed floor bearing ring, stairwell, guards and a separate roof ladder. Public processional width1.80/headroom2.95 differs deliberately from BellService .95/2.0; public waypoints are not a proof of the spiral service path. Route edges carry actual opening IDs and materialized solids/surfaces. Signed coordinates, zero floor datum and empty inactive collections remain intentional. Slot counter offsets for final service surfaces are bounded authored values; downstream rendering, collision and route validation remain explicit source dependencies. No tests, checks, generation or source edits.
